sources.title: متصفّح الويب Google Chrome

sources.title: Google Chrome – Download the fast, secure browser from Google
sources.snippet: Get more done with the new Google Chrome. A more simple, secure and faster web browser than ever, with Google’s smarts built in. …

sources.title: تحديث Google Chrome - جهاز الكمبيوتر - مساعدة متصفح Google Chrome
